description: Country info API: ISO 3166 codes (alpha-2, alpha-3, numeric), currency (ISO 4217), international calling code, official languages, time zones, weekend days and first day of the week for 249 countries and territories, including all 54 African countries, India, the Gulf states and Asia. Also region, 12h or 24h clock, metric or US units and paper size. Sources: Unicode CLDR 48.2, IANA tz database 2026e and Google libphonenumber. Useful for forms, invoicing, scheduling across weekends (Friday-Saturday in Saudi Arabia and Egypt) and localising messages. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country codes, comma-separated, up to 60 (default: all 249 countries and territories)

name: country_info_lookup
title: Country info: ISO codes, currency, calling code, languages, time zones and weekend days for 249 countries
